_meta.description: Wonslate translation-quality benchmark set: 9 language pairs, both directions, 6 segments each (108 samples per engine).
_meta.authoring: English sources are original sentences; target-language references are expert-quality human-style translations written for this benchmark. Each 'a'/'b' segment pair is used in both directions: a->b scores against b, b->a scores against a.
_meta.scoring_hint: corpus-level chrF++ (word_order=2) and BLEU; BLEU uses the char tokenizer for zh/ja/ko targets.
